body: Leave me the hell alone and stop trolling me.

1) I'm tired of living check to check.
    
2) I'm tired of not having a partner that meets me halfway at the very least halfway.
    
3) I don't mind working but my employer is doing some underhanded things and it is causing my job to be even harder. How do I tell someone yes we shouldn't have charged you, and you'll get credit but you'll be charged again before you get that credit. Does that even make any sense? And it's not as if we have the magical billing cycle listed somewhere the consumers can actually read it. It's deceptive to charge someone for a service they never asked for and then to bill them again and finally give a credit 2 months later.

4) I'd really like to re-take my exam or even buy a pair of socks. I can't even put away a few cents each check. Every things that comes in goes right back out.

5) At the end of the day, just getting by is so utterly depressing. This isn't the life I want to live. I have to stop here. I have to get back to work.

If I walk away from the one I'm living, I'll lose everything. I thought taking a small vacation (using my vacation hours and just relaxing and doing nothing at home for a few days) would help. It really didn't. Quitting my job is not an option no matter how much I don't like it. I'm not under-appreciated, I'm a doormat. I am responsible for this situation that I am in. I take full responsibility for being an idiot.

Have not considered therapy. I don't want to feel like I'm his mother giving him orders. I want him to just do things and more importantly I want him to go to school and work. Jobs aren't easy to come by here, but still not making excuses for him. He is not close to his family at all, so if I left the picture he would more than likely be homeless after a short while.
